stories.title: India’s wholesale price index jumps to 11.39% in September
stories.summary: The Wholesale Price Index (WPI) in India rose to an annual 11.39% in September, up from 9.9% in August, as fuel and food prices increased sharply. Retail inflation also rose to 5.54% in September, driven mainly by higher vegetable prices. Analysts point to uneven monsoon rainfall, El Nino risks and higher global commodity prices as factors that could keep food‑price pressures elevated.
stories.why: The higher wholesale and retail inflation signals persistent price pressures in the Indian economy.

stories.title: Just 5 years in, interactive chatbot platform Character.AI files for bankruptcy
stories.summary: Only five years into its journey, Character.AI, which lets users create AI characters and have conversations with them, has filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy, following a slew of lawsuits and struggles to scale its popular platform. In a court document, the company said it had assets and liabilities between $50 million and $100 million.
stories.why: This matters because it could change AI capabilities, costs, adoption, regulation or competitive positioning.

stories.title: Scimplify raises $25M to challenge China’s grip on critical materials with AI
stories.summary: As manufacturers across industries strive to reduce their reliance on Chinese suppliers, Indian startup Scimplify has raised $25 million to expand its AI-powered approach to producing specialty chemicals and critical materials, with semiconductors, defense and energy emerging as key growth markets. The latest investment brings Scimplify’s total equity funding to $80 million, the startup said, though it declined to disclose its valuation.
stories.why: This matters because it could change AI capabilities, costs, adoption, regulation or competitive positioning.

stories.title: 10 Nifty500 stocks that have fallen up to 58% in a year
stories.summary: The Indian equity market has witnessed considerable weakness over the past year, with the benchmark Nifty 50 declining 10% and the broader Nifty 500 index slipping 5%. Among these, 10 stocks have emerged as notable laggards, with losses ranging from 47% to 58% over the past year.
stories.why: This can affect market expectations, company valuations, sector sentiment or capital flows.

stories.title: IMF warns of risks from AI boom and debt, but raises forecast for world growth
stories.summary: The international body slightly upgraded its outlook for the world economy, but warned that risks of an AI-related market correction and job losses because of the technology, as well as government debt, remain concerns. That's up from its July forecast for three per cent growth and well below the 3.5 per cent expansion in 2025.
stories.why: Changes in the global growth outlook can influence markets, trade, borrowing conditions and business investment across countries.

stories.title: India-US trade deal heading towards ‘landing point’, EAM Jaishankar says
stories.summary: External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar indicated that India and the US are advancing their trade deal negotiations. Jaishankar emphasized that the negotiations are complex due to competitive agreements being made by the US with other economies.
stories.why: The outcome could change tariffs, market access and trade conditions for businesses in both countries.
